<thought>To locate the template that converts an aliphatic alcohol into its trimethylsilyl (TMS) ether, I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that break the “aliphatic hydroxyls” functional group (the O–H bond of the alcohol) and form the “trimethylsilyl” functional group (the O–Si bond). This should return the appropriate template ID and its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["trimethylsilyl"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
